params.prompt: Create a production game VFX animation SPRITE SHEET matching the supplied reference effect precisely in material, palette and line quality. The reference is the existing dagger THRUST trail: jagged fine violet filaments, deep purple shadow streaks, a hairline electric magenta-white core, sparse sharp glowing splinters, mostly transparent empty space. Make its companion DAGGER CUT effect. Curve those SAME textured filaments into one asymmetric short sweeping arc, like a hooked streak of torn purple lightning, convex toward screen RIGHT (+X), two fine trailing tails tapering LEFT. This is a fleeting close-range dagger slash, not a magical crescent projectile. Preserve the reference's saturated purple color, sparse energy density, dark gaps and textured fringe. A narrow white core occupies no more than one tenth of the effect's thickness. No broad white filled blade, no pastel lavender ribbon, no turquoise/cyan outlines, no smooth solid crescent, no thick bloom cloud. Exactly SIX square cells arranged THREE columns by TWO rows. Read left to right then next row: 1 tiny curved violet spark, 2 growing broken filament sweep, 3 sharp full contact arc with narrow luminous core and trailing strands, 4 fragmented follow-through arc, 5 dissolving purple wisps, 6 a few dim short splinters. Every cell is a different temporal stage, same fixed center and scale, isolated with generous padding. Peak spans about 70% cell width and 30% cell height, fine irregular texture remains readable at a rendered width of 160px. Background must be perfectly flat uniform pure GREEN #00FF00 for chroma extraction, no black backdrop from reference. No character, weapon, hands, ground, shadows, text, numbering, borders or grid lines. Match the reference dagger thrust's gritty sharp anime shadow-energy treatment, only change its trajectory from straight to curved.

context: Replace a mismatched dagger slash effect with a textured purple trail matching the existing thrust effect.
processing: Six fixed cells; shared scale and pivot; chroma removal/despill; native +X sweep; no per-frame mirroring or normalization.
revision_reason: The first pale, smooth, broad crescent did not match the existing thin purple filament thrust. Regenerated against the actual existing thrust asset.
